verses.text: Our citizenship is in heaven. And we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.title: Longing For Jesus’ Return

verses.text: Psalm 63 A psalm of David. When he was in the Desert of Judah. You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.
A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
